name: Half Moon
positioning: Independent beach resort near Montego Bay on 400 acres with two miles of private beachfront, combining the historic Founders Cove, the Eclipse at Half Moon area and staffed villas
best_for: Families who want a children's village, horses and included water sports
Groups who want a staffed villa with a private pool
Golfers and spa-goers who want both on one estate

facts.text: Half Moon is set on 400 acres with two miles of private beachfront.
Eclipse at Half Moon is framed by the Caribbean Sea to the north and lush hillsides to the south.
Founders Cove began with ten cottages.
Eclipse is home to Fern Tree, a Salamander Spa.
The spa's therapies combine indigenous ingredients with international brands and techniques.
The spa offers a Jamaican Bush Bath steeped with fresh herbs, roots, leaves and fruits.
Estate Ocean Suites sit in private Estate Houses surrounded by tropical gardens.
Estate Ocean Suite bedrooms have private outdoor showers.
Half Moon has a championship golf course.
Half Moon has its own Children's Village.
Delmare is a seafood restaurant with Italian influences overlooking the white sand beach of Eclipse.

highlights.text: Eclipse has an infinity-edge swimming pool and a private beachfront with a natural swimming cove.
Spa guests can choose an overwater cabana for their treatment.
Half Moon has an Equestrian Centre, and activities include swimming with horses.
The villas are fully staffed with a cook, housekeeper and butler, and each has a private pool.
Kayaks, pedal boats and paddleboards are included in a stay.

considerations.text: The villas are 15 minutes from Montego Bay's Sangster International Airport.
WhataHotel notes the resort is large, so getting between facilities may mean walking or using transportation.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
